# B mechanism: exhaustive saved-data analysis

Existing finite TEST description; natural-point gradient and exact rounded TC/native targets, other methods scalar summaries only; no endpoint-gradient or causal bias/population claim.

All 18,432 saved cells / 256 blocks are retained. No new model calls, derivatives, fits or resampling. Natural-point gradients are reused; exact rounded native and TC targets define their residual norm, dot product and cosine. The nonlinear remainder identity is checked per cell. Stage1 is the separately accepted controlled residual experiment.

Shown below: pooled sides within each frame/operator/dose. The JSON retains separate sides as well. ## Limits

- Already observed finite TEST; no fresh confirmation, p values or population claim.
- Natural-point gradients g_y are distinct from stage1 true-native-endpoint gradients g_N.
- Pooled here includes all three frames so/when/transfer, unlike the earlier B primary so/when mixture. Pooled summaries use balanced conditions within block and equal block weights; no mean of per-record relative ratios.
- Repeated endpoint0 values are condition-balanced reuse, not independent endpoints.
- A centered cross-energy or mean bias does not identify a training cause.

Independent actual completion review is recorded separately; this renderer does not issue scientific approval.
